comment: Kepler-1633 b; ephemeris from DR24 (Coughlin+2016); true period 186.404 d as in DR22/DR24 (Mullally+2015, Coughlin+2016), Morton+2016 (validation), Holczer+2016 (8 transits), Gajdos+2019 (Exoplanet Archive ps); DR25 and Lissauer+2024 give 62.13 d (Thompson+2018); Twicken+2016: period ambiguous, observed every other quarter; ALDERAAN test (notes/K05568/): only even quarters observed, all 62.13 d epochs that are not 186.4 d epochs fall in gaps, so Kepler data cannot distinguish; 186.4 d is the longest consistent period

marked FP (no reliable transit parameters); duration from DR24 (DR25 and Lissauer+2024 give 0.052 h, too short for b ~ 1.0 at P = 0.875 d, a/R* ~ 2.4); depth: no reasonable catalog value (0 in DR25 and Lissauer+2024, empty in DR24; DR25 ror = 0.0037 implies ~14 ppm), not overridden

marked FP (no reliable transit parameters); no override: duration is 12.9 h in DR24 and 0 h in Lissauer+2024; both fits give a/R* ~ 1.0, but the stellar density (Berger+2023) gives a/R* ~ 2.9 and a central duration ~ 3.7 h; no reasonable catalog value

marked FP (no reliable transit parameters); depth, duration, impact from Lissauer+2024: the only DR entry (DR22, FALSE POSITIVE) has an unphysical fit (impact 2.32, ror 1.35, a/R* 2188, duration 0.63 h); the Lissauer+2024 duration 17.8 h agrees with ~19 h from the stellar density (Berger+2023)
